steps.path: The strip across the top of a phone screen
steps.headline: Which name button do you want between the two pairs of buttons?
steps.hint: Each phone keeps your layout: ☰ and Projects on the left, + New session and the terminal switch on the right. Tap the session name in each.
steps.risk: The status lights show at most 12 other sessions. Being this small, they're for a glance ("something's green or red"), not for telling sessions apart; tap the name for the list.

variants.label: Round 2's version
variants.summary: For comparison: the name in an outlined pill, a separate arrow, and a "10" count beside it.

variants.label: One plain button
variants.summary: Your note: the status dot, the name and the arrow are one button with one shared highlight, no outline and no count. Tapping anywhere on it opens the list.

variants.label: Plain + status lights
variants.summary: The same button, plus a row of tiny lights under the name, one per other open session, in each one's status colour (green working, red needs you, blue reply ready). Idle sessions are faint.

steps.path: The ☰ button at the top left
steps.headline: What should ☰ open on a phone?
steps.hint: Tap ☰ at the top left of each phone. In the last one, tapping the session name still opens the plain session list.
steps.risk: In the everything panel, tapping a chat under Earlier opens the Resume page for now. The finished version would reopen that chat directly. The workbench's practice data has few past chats, so Earlier is short here.

variants.label: Today's small menu
variants.summary: ☰ opens the small menu (Settings, Projects, Pages, Files, Games) under the button.

variants.label: Side drawer (round 2)
variants.summary: For comparison: the panel from round 2. Your open sessions, Resume / New session, then the places as a list.

variants.label: Everything panel
variants.summary: Your note: one panel from the left with a big New session button on top, your open sessions, your five most recent past chats with See all, and Games, Files, Pages, Projects and Settings as a row of buttons along the bottom.

steps.path: The row of pills under the message box, on a phone browser connected to your computer
steps.headline: Do the pills match each other now?
steps.hint: Swipe the pill row under the message box sideways and tap a few.
steps.changed: Every pill now has the same height, corners, padding and text size, including the pencil at the end. Remote is just a small computer icon. Pills keep their colour only where it means something: the model's brand, the permission mode, a helper that needs you.
steps.notice: The row reads as one set instead of seven different shapes.
steps.risk: In this round the matching shapes are applied over the existing pills. The finished version would build every pill from one shared piece, so a new pill can't drift. The computer icon alone may not say "connected to your computer" to a new user. The words are in its hint, but a phone only shows hints on a long press.
